description: This file defines React components for a custom radio group UI element, utilizing primitives from @radix-ui/react-radio-group and styling utilities. It exports two components: RadioGroup and RadioGroupItem, allowing the use of a themed, styled radio button group with custom indicators.

methods.name: RadioGroup
methods.description: A React component that renders a radix-ui RadioGroup primitive with custom styling and passes through props.

methods.name: RadioGroupItem
methods.description: A React component that renders a styled radio button item with a custom indicator icon, utilizing radix-ui primitives.
